Olesko New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains an apparent internal inconsistency worth noting: Hanoch-Genneh Meyer (1800–1884) is described as having founded the Olesk Hasidic dynasty 'in the middle of the 18th century,' a date that would predate his own birth by decades — likely a source error for the 19th century. A later Hasidic court, led by Hanoch-Genekh Vagshal, sat in the town in the early 20th century. This is the newer of Olesko's two Jewish cemeteries, its oldest preserved gravestone from the end of the 18th century, and presumably bought and fenced by the Jewish community itself.
